---create datawarehouse table---

CREATE TABLE dw.DimCustomer
(
    CustomerKey   INT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL,   -- surrogate key
    CustomerID    INT NOT NULL,                 -- business key
    CustomerName  NVARCHAR(100),
    City          NVARCHAR(50),
    Email         NVARCHAR(100),
    LoadDate      DATETIME2,
    UpdatedDate   DATETIME2
)
WITH (DISTRIBUTION = REPLICATE, CLUSTERED INDEX (CustomerID));


--- change source table data---
update stg.Customer set city='banglore' where CustomerID=1;
insert into stg.Customer VALUES(4,'priya','nagpur','priya@mail.com');

---chnage scd1 overwrite--

MERGE dw.DimCustomer AS T
USING stg.Customer AS S
ON T.CustomerID = S.CustomerID

WHEN MATCHED
AND (
       ISNULL(T.CustomerName,'') <> ISNULL(S.CustomerName,'')
    OR ISNULL(T.City,'')         <> ISNULL(S.City,'')
    OR ISNULL(T.Email,'')        <> ISNULL(S.Email,'')
)
THEN
    UPDATE SET
        T.CustomerName = S.CustomerName,
        T.City         = S.City,
        T.Email        = S.Email,
        T.UpdatedDate  = GETDATE()

WHEN NOT MATCHED BY TARGET
THEN
    INSERT
    (
        CustomerID,
        CustomerName,
        City,
        Email,
        LoadDate,
        UpdatedDate
    )
    VALUES
    (
        S.CustomerID,
        S.CustomerName,
        S.City,
        S.Email,
        GETDATE(),
        GETDATE()
    );

%%sql
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS dim_customer_scd1 (
    CustomerID   INT,
    CustomerName STRING,
    City         STRING
)
USING DELTA;

%%sql
INSERT INTO dim_customer_scd1 VALUES
(101, 'Amit',  'Pune'),
(102, 'Neha',  'Mumbai'),
(103, 'Rahul', 'Delhi');

%%sql
CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP VIEW source_customer AS
SELECT 101 AS CustomerID, 'Amit'  AS CustomerName, 'Bangalore' AS City
UNION ALL
SELECT 104, 'Priya', 'Chennai';

%%sql
MERGE INTO dim_customer_scd1 AS tgt
USING source_customer AS src
ON tgt.CustomerID = src.CustomerID

WHEN MATCHED AND (tgt.CustomerName <> src.CustomerName OR tgt.City <> src.City)
THEN UPDATE SET
    tgt.CustomerName = src.CustomerName,
    tgt.City         = src.City

WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (CustomerID, CustomerName, City)
VALUES (src.CustomerID, src.CustomerName, src.City);
%%sql
SELECT * FROM dim_customer_scd1 ORDER BY CustomerID;

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from delta.tables import DeltaTable

silver_path = "abfss://synapse-filename@synapase.dfs.core.windows.net/silver/customer"
gold_path = "abfss://synapse-filename@synapase.dfs.core.windows.net/gold/customer_scd2"

silver_df = spark.read.format("delta").load(silver_path)

silver_df.show(truncate=False)

"""implement scd2 first timein silver layer"""
gold_df = (
    silver_df
    .withColumn("start_date", F.to_date("updated_at"))
    .withColumn("end_date", F.lit(None).cast("date"))
    .withColumn("is_current", F.lit(True))
)

gold_df.write \
    .format("delta") \
    .mode("overwrite") \
    .save(gold_path)

gold_table = DeltaTable.forPath(spark, gold_path)

gold_table.alias("tgt").merge(
    silver_df.alias("src"),
    "tgt.customer_id = src.customer_id AND tgt.is_current = true"
).whenMatchedUpdate(
    condition="""
        NOT (tgt.customer_name <=> src.customer_name)
        OR NOT (tgt.city <=> src.city)
        OR NOT (tgt.state <=> src.state)
    """,
    set={
        "end_date": "current_date()",
        "is_current": "false"
    }
).execute()

gold_table = DeltaTable.forPath(spark, gold_path)

gold_table.alias("tgt").merge(
    silver_df.alias("src"),
    "tgt.customer_id = src.customer_id AND tgt.is_current = true"
).whenNotMatchedInsert(
    values={
        "customer_id": "src.customer_id",
        "customer_name": "src.customer_name",
        "city": "src.city",
        "state": "src.state",
        "created_at": "src.created_at",
        "updated_at": "src.updated_at",
        "start_date": "current_date()",
        "end_date": "CAST(NULL AS DATE)",
        "is_current": "true"
    }
).execute()

final_gold_df = spark.read.format("delta").load(gold_path)

final_gold_df.orderBy(
    "customer_id", "start_date"
).show(truncate=False)
